answer: An environmental attestation protocol counters Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to physical field entropy. Nodes patrolling juniper groves must correlate optical spectra of floral nectar with acoustic bearings of a local raven. Because spoofing co-located signals requires physical presence, an attacker incurs dedicated hardware costs per identity. However, seasonal floral dormancy or avian silence can disrupt telemetry baselines, spuriously rejecting honest agents.
